method: Native PNG and native reference viewed independently with view_image; shape, phase, accessories and profile assessed. No image mutation.
scope: Second visual reading only; not source-pixel identity, opposite-side validation, animation or timing certification. RGB beneath zero alpha is not treated as a rendered halo.

entries.observation: Profil droit entier ; tête-lame continue, petit bord arrière et bras bridés conservés, deux pieds visibles. Aucun outil libre ajouté.
entries.limits: Marge haute serrée (visible alpha>=8 commence à y=8), pointe entière ; détails fins et trajet des sangles reconstruits.

entries.limits: Tube court conservé comme accessoire, sans fouet ni projectile ; côté opposé non documenté.
